_README: THE certified configuration of the greedy width-1 worker. One record, read
by both greedy_reduce.py (which aborts at import) and
hierarchical_reduction.py (which pins the environment it writes into every
Condor submit). Before this file each kept its own copy of the same eight
variables -- if those ever drifted, the orchestrator would pin one thing
while the worker demanded another, and nothing would notice.
PROVENANCE: env_set was CAPTURED from a real certified run, not written
from memory. greedy_worker.py snapshots os.environ after its own defaults
and before importing greedy_reduce, and stores it in every result.pkl as
'env_snapshot'. This record was frozen from cluster 1921442 on the target
Reconstructing this by reading source files got it wrong twice in one
sitting; capture does not have opinions.

env_set._why: Semantic. Wrong or missing -> a different search that still reports success. SAILIR_ROUTE_MAX_S gates symmetry routing by total numerator degree s: above it, an integral is not routed at all and goes to worker dispatch. s is a PROXY, not the cause -- routing cost comes from the CASCADE (canonical_monolithic_rule composes across transforms and recursively routes what it emits), and neither s nor the individual numerator powers predict it. Measured: s=24 with powers {3,7,14} routed to ONE term, s=16 with powers {8,1,7} gave 6,435, s=20 gave 1,315,600. What s buys is PREDICTABILITY and a check that costs nothing (it runs BEFORE the expansion, unlike SAILIR_ROUTE_MAX_TERMS which only rejects after the terms are built). Everything sampled at s<=5 produced small rules: 0, 1, 16, 45 terms. The price is forgoing cheap high-s wins like that s=24 single-term route.

env_set_perf._why: Speed only, results identical. Not guarded as semantics, but a wrong value is a ~20x cliff, so it is still recorded and pinned.

env_model._why: Tied to the checkpoint, not to the search. SAILIR_SYM_STORE selects the transform store that topo_config.canonicalize_module() -- canonicalize2 for gravity3L -- loads, and canonicalize2 derives its prime from that store's prod_point, so the two cannot disagree. SAILIR_SYM_PRIME is deliberately NOT set: it is read only by canonicalize_GR, a separate lineage that no runtime routing call imports.

_why: The closing rule, and the reason this record is a whitelist rather than
a list of knobs. A guard that only checks names it knows cannot catch
SAILIR_SYM_FIRST=1, which makes the worker return a symmetry rule with
steps=0 and never enter the greedy search at all. Every one of these was

Four of these were found only after the audit stopped using a hand-picked list of files and started following imports: they live in reduction/topo_config.py and reduction/eqact_infer.py, which the worker imports but which were outside the original scan. SAILIR_CANONICALIZE and SAILIR_CANON_MAPS_PKL override the topology's own canonicalization module and its map pickle -- i.e. they change what an integral canonicalizes TO, which is upstream of the entire search.

env_free._why: Deliberately variable per campaign. None changes the path taken on a solved target; they bound how long a run may take before it gives up. SAILIR_ROOT only relocates the repo path and falls back to the production literal; it selects no algorithm.

env_derived._why: Set by the worker as a function of --v7-cpus, before any numpy import. Not independent handles; listed so the audit does not flag them.

params._why: greedy_reduce() keyword arguments that define the selection rule. Each has an abort in greedy_reduce.

params_free._why: Per-target or per-campaign; do not change which action is chosen.

params_fixed_by_worker._why: greedy_worker.py always passes these; recorded so a change is visible.

cli._why: Checked by hierarchical_reduction.greedy_check_certified(). The env guard cannot see CLI values, so these are checked there or not at all. A wrong prime is SILENT: the p101 model was trained on a corpus generated entirely at 101, and at the repo-default 1009 the coefficient encoding is wrong with no error.

cli_free._why: Per-target paths and per-campaign limits. --prime and --v7-cpus appear here as flags the worker ACCEPTS, while their VALUES are pinned under 'cli' and enforced by greedy_check_certified(); --verbose is the alias of -v.

cli_must_not_be_used._why: Accepted by the parser (parse_known_args tolerates anything) but NOT part of the certified configuration. Several name features that were stripped out of the module entirely, so passing them is silently inert rather than an error. --paper-masters-only is now BANNED, not merely inert. ibp_env.is_master already implements the terminal set we want -- paper masters UNION corner integrals in sectors the basis does not cover -- and this flag short-circuits it (`if PAPER_MASTERS_ONLY: return False`), making those corners NON-terminal. A corner cannot be reduced by IBP within its own sector (nothing is simpler there) and SAILIR_SYM_FIRST is unset, so a worker handed one has no legal way down: it grinds until the memory guard kills it. Measured: (1,0,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,...) -- r=9 s=0, the least exotic integral in the g1023 frontier -- was killed at 15 GB, and the closure builder failed on it with 'pivot absent after substitution'. Three of the six L9r9 frontier integrals were lost this way, and the reduction cannot complete without them. Terminating at corners is correct and strictly EARLIER, so nothing already-solved changes.

data_inputs._why: CONTENT hashes of the files the certified run read. Paths alone are not enough: editing the pickle a pinned path points at changes the answers while every other guard passes. Directories hash as sorted (relpath, sha256) over their files, so an added or renamed file also changes it. Verify with scripts/greedy_data_hashes.py --check.

cli_required._why: Flags that must be passed EXPLICITLY. --no-paper-masters-only is required because --paper-masters-only is BooleanOptionalAction with default=True on BOTH the orchestrator and the worker: omitting it leaves paper-masters-only ON. Verified by the frontier still showing L9r9:6 after the flag was removed, instead of 4 with the two corners counted as masters. The terminal set must be paper masters UNION corners -- IBP cannot reduce a corner within its own sector, so a worker handed one has no legal move and grinds until the memory guard kills it. --use-symmetry is REQUIRED: the corpus sampled targets only from the 298 canonical sectors and every truth trajectory is pure IBP, but 69% of reductions from a canonical parent emit NON-canonical daughters (213/307 measured). A non-canonical integral descends only by a symmetry relabelling, which IBP cannot perform -- the identity to the master ascends the order -- so without routing the worker has no legal move and grinds to the memory guard. Routing is free (cache entry, no worker), cascades to survivors, and is value-preserving.
